sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Prohibition Of Public Meetings On Public Thoroughfares Act 1973
sections.description:
Short title, extent and application

Balochistan Prohibition Of Public Meetings (On Public Thoroughfares) Act
1973
Balochistan
Prohibition Of Public Meetings (On Public Thoroughfares) Act 1973
ACT XI OF 1973
An Act to provide for
prohibition of holding of Public Meetings on Public Thoroughfares in the
interest of public order and security.
[Gazette of
Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 10th October 1973]
No. Legis-X-(8)/73.-The
Baluchistan Prohibition of Public Meetings (on Public Thoroughfares) Bill,
1973, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Baluchistan on 29th
September 1973, and assented to by the Governor of Baluchistan on 5th October
1973, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
It is hereby enacted as follows
:-
1. Short title, extent and
application.-(1) This Act may be called the Baluchistan Prohibition of
Public Meetings (on Public Thoroughfares) Act, 1973.
(2) It shall extend to the whole
of the Province of Baluchistan except Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

2. Definitions.-For the
purpose of this Act, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or
context :-
(a)
"District Magistrate" means the District Magistrate as defined in the
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898) ;
(b)
"Meeting" means a meeting laid for the purposes of discussion of
matters of public interest, or, for the purpose of expression of views on such
matters ;
(c) "Public
meeting" includes any meeting which the public or any section thereof are
permitted to attend whether on payment or otherwise ;
(d) "Public
thoroughfare" means any highway, any public bridge, road, including foot
way, square to which the public have or are permitted to have access whether on
payment or otherwise.
(e) "promoter" means a person
or class of persons who call, hold, arrange or address a public meeting.
